name: Water Curtain Cave
location: the very summit of Flower-Fruit Mountain
environment: A waterfall veils the entrance; a stone tablet is inscribed “Blessed Land of Flower-Fruit Mountain, Grotto-Heaven of Water Curtain Cave,” and inside are stone seats, stone beds, stone pots and stone stoves.
furnishings: Stone seats, stone beds, stone stools, stone basins and stone bowls, all naturally formed.
treasures: The stone tablet, the iron-plank bridge, and the waterfall's heavenly curtain.
subordinates: Four Stalwart Generals · Marshals Ma and Liu
demon kings of the seventy-two caves
feature: A heaven-born stone cave where the Great Sage Equaling Heaven rose to power.

name: Black Wind Cave
region: Kingdom of Ussa · Black Wind Mountain
location: Black Wind Cave on Black Wind Mountain
environment: High mountains and deep ravines, black mist swirling, pines and cypresses in groves.
furnishings: Spacious inside, furnished with stone stools and a meditation couch.
treasures: The Brocade Kasaya (stolen from Guanyin's monastery).
territory: a hundred li around Black Wind Mountain
feature: A rare “Chan-practicing” type among demon kings, able to discuss the Way and expound scriptures.

name: Yellow Wind Cave
region: Yellow Wind Ridge · Yellow Wind Cave
location: deep in Yellow Wind Ridge
environment: Yellow sand blots out the sun; jagged rocks abound.
furnishings: A deep cave-mansion with a demon-king's throne.
treasures: The Samadhi Divine Wind (a spell, not a treasure).
feature: A yellow-furred marten that attained the Way at the foot of Spirit Mountain, with ties to the Buddhist order.

name: Wave-Moon Cave
location: deep in Bowl Mountain
environment: The mountain crouches like a tiger; moonlight shimmers on the ripples.
furnishings: A lavish cave-mansion with a “Hundred-Flowers Pavilion.”
treasures: None (relies on a Heavenly Court background).
feature: Kui Wood Wolf of the Heavenly Court descended to earth and took the “princess,” the daughter of the King of Precious Elephant Kingdom, as his wife.

name: Lotus Cave on Flat-Top Mountain
owner: Golden Horn King · Silver Horn King
location: the highest peak of Flat-Top Mountain
environment: The mountain is shaped like an inverted lotus, often sealed in cloud and mist.
furnishings: A vast cave-mansion with “red-lacquered wooden stools” and “gold-lacquered tables.”
treasures: the Purple-Gold Red Gourd, the White-Jade Pure Vase, the Seven-Star Sword, the Plantain Fan and the Golden-Lasso Rope.
feature: Lord Lao's pill-refining page boys descended to earth, with the most lavish magical-treasure setup.

name: Fire-Cloud Cave of Mount Hao
region: Mount Hao · Withered-Pine Gorge · Fire-Cloud Cave
location: Withered-Pine Gorge on Mount Hao
environment: Pines withered and the gorge dry, with searing heat rising.
furnishings: The cave interior is crimson, as if on fire.
treasures: True Samadhi Fire (an innate spell).
territory: six hundred li of Mount Hao
feature: Son of the Bull Demon King, a juvenile demon king who can unleash True Samadhi Fire.

name: Turtle Mansion of the Tongtian River
location: the bed of the Tongtian River
environment: Crystal palace halls, with waves for a roof.
furnishings: A crystal throne and coral trees.
treasures: The Nine-Petal Bronze Hammer.
feature: A goldfish from Guanyin's lotus pond that demands boys and girls to eat.

name: Jindou Cave
location: the sunny side of Mount Jindou
environment: Ten thousand golden rays, a thousand streams of auspicious vapor.
furnishings: The cave-mansion seems cast of gold.
treasures: The Diamond Snare (a treasure of Lord Lao).
feature: Lord Lao's green ox descended to earth; the Diamond Snare snared away all the gods' weapons.

name: Pipa Cave
location: on West Liang Mountain outside the capital of the Kingdom of Women
environment: Poisonous vapor swirling; the cave is shaped like a pipa.
furnishings: Lavish as palace chambers.
treasures: Three-Pronged Steel Fork · Horse-Toppling Poison Sting (an innate spell).
territory: the outskirts of the Kingdom of Women
feature: A venomous Scorpion Demon that stung the Buddha and whom even Guanyin dares not approach.

name: Plantain Cave of Emerald-Cloud Mountain
owner: Princess Iron Fan · Bull Demon King
location: the summit of Emerald-Cloud Mountain
environment: Emerald green covering the mountain, wreathed in cloud and mist.
furnishings: A deep and secluded cave-mansion with “cinnabar lattice” and “gold-lacquered tables and stools.”
treasures: The Plantain Fan (one fan sends one flying eighty-four thousand li).
territory: Emerald-Cloud Mountain + eight hundred li of Flaming Mountain
feature: Owned by the Rākṣasī; her fan quenched the great fire of Flaming Mountain.

name: Cloud-Touching Cave of Thunder-Hoard Mountain
location: the summit of Thunder-Hoard Mountain
environment: Clouds scrape the Milky Way; heaped thunder forms the peak.
furnishings: Relics of the Princess of Ten Thousand Saints, halls full of pearls and jade.
treasures: The Bull King's Golden-Eyed Beast.
feature: The Bull Demon King's mistress's residence, the legacy of the “Ten-Thousand-Year Fox King.”

name: Jade-Wave Pool of Boulder Mountain
owner: Nine-Headed Son-in-Law · Dragon King of Ten Thousand Saints
location: the pool bed beneath Boulder Mountain
environment: A deep pool of jade-green water, with pearls by the ten-thousand measures.
furnishings: Crystal palaces with coral railings.
treasures: The Buddha's relic (śarīra) · Nine-Leaf Lingzhi Herb.
territory: the pool bed of Boulder Mountain
feature: A dragon-palace-style cave-mansion; the Princess of Ten Thousand Saints stole the Buddha's śarīra relic.

name: Minor Thunderclap Monastery
region: Little Western Heaven · Minor Thunderclap Monastery
location: the false-Buddha ground of Little Western Heaven
environment: A solemn temple appearance, with false Buddha statues standing in rows.
furnishings: The precious hall of the false Thunderclap Monastery.
treasures: Golden Cymbals · Seedbag of Humankind · Wolf-Tooth Club.
territory: a hundred li of Little Western Heaven
feature: Maitreya Buddha's stone-chime page descended to earth; the false Thunderclap Monastery is the largest in scale.

name: Rotten-Persimmon Lane
location: deep within Rotten-Persimmon Lane
environment: The stench of persimmons fills the sky; snakes and pythons coil there.
furnishings: None (a wild snake's den).
treasures: None
feature: A great python that has not cultivated a human form; “Rotten-Persimmon Lane” is unbearably foul.

name: Silk-Web Cave
location: a shady spot on Silk-Web Ridge
environment: Silk webs fill the sky; a gloomy, ghostly air.
furnishings: Stone tables and stools, with a bath at “Purgation Spring.”
treasures: The silk-thread magic web.
feature: Seven sisters live together, fellow disciples of the Hundred-Eyed Demon of Yellow-Flower Monastery.

name: Lion-Camel Cave
owner: Azure Lion · White Elephant · Great Roc
region: Lion-Camel Ridge · Lion-Camel Cave · Lion-Camel Kingdom
location: eight hundred li of Lion-Camel Ridge
environment: “Skulls heaped like a ridge, bones like a forest,” with blood reeking to the sky.
furnishings: “Human flesh for food, human bones for fuel.”
treasures: The Yin-Yang Two-Qi Vase (the Great Roc's).
subordinates: forty-seven to forty-eight thousand lesser demons · over a hundred spirits
territory: eight hundred li of Lion-Camel Ridge + Lion-Camel Kingdom
feature: A three-demon-king conglomerate; a whole kingdom of demon atmosphere on an unprecedented scale.

name: Qinghua Manor
owner: Deer Demon · State Preceptor of the Bhikṣu Kingdom
location: outside the capital of the Bhikṣu Kingdom
environment: Willows cast shade; serene and otherworldly as a fairyland.
furnishings: Elegant as an immortal's residence.
treasures: The Coiled-Dragon Staff.
territory: the capital of the Bhikṣu Kingdom
feature: The white deer mount of the Old Man of the South Pole descended to earth, intending to use 1,111 children's hearts and livers.

name: Bottomless Cave of Sunken-Empty Mountain
location: the deep bottom of Sunken-Empty Mountain
environment: “Black vapor covers the mountain; the bottom cannot be fathomed.”
furnishings: Inside the cave there is another “grotto-heaven,” with spirit tablets for the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li and his daughter.
treasures: None (relies on a Spirit Mountain background).
feature: Sworn daughter of the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li; she stole the crystal lamp oil at Spirit Mountain.

name: Linked-Circle Cave of Hidden-Mist Mountain
location: deep in Hidden-Mist Mountain
environment: Mist that never clears all year.
furnishings: Six linked gates, layer upon layer of mechanisms.
treasures: Fake human heads (a false-surrender ruse).
feature: A hidden leopard of the Southern Mountains who used the “Plum-Blossom Splitting” scheme to feign defeat against Wukong.

name: Nine-Curve Winding Cave
location: the summit of Bamboo-Joint Mountain
environment: Bamboo shadows swaying; the cave-mansion winds through nine turns.
furnishings: Nine winding links, unfathomably deep.
treasures: The Nine-Headed Dharma Body.
subordinates: Yellow Lion · Suan Lion · Suanni · Tuan Elephant · Bai Ze · Fuli · Nao Lion · Snow Lion · Tuan Lion
feature: The nine-headed lion mount of the Heavenly Venerable Taiyi, “Nine-Spirits Primordial Sage” commands the demons.

name: Dark-Splendor Cave of Green-Dragon Mountain
location: the sunny side of Green-Dragon Mountain
environment: Dark mountain rock, gleaming with cold light.
furnishings: The cave-mansion is like a rhinoceros-horn palace.
treasures: Rhinoceros horns (the source of their perfumed oil).
feature: Three rhinoceros demons disguised as the Buddha to steal perfumed oil, consuming fifty thousand jin a year.

name: Rabbit Warren of Mount Maoying
location: five peaks and three warrens of Mount Maoying
environment: The mountain is shaped like a rabbit, with five peaks and three warrens.
furnishings: None (a natural rabbit warren).
treasures: The Medicine-Pounding Pestle.
feature: The Jade Rabbit of the Moon Palace, who sought to take Tang Sanzang as her mate.
